topic: Equipment shipment and future ordering for Estonia
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on shipping equipment to the Estonian office while Rasmus is on vacation. The initial shipment involves a Lidar unit, and it was confirmed that DataCorp had not approved or rejected an idea regarding the casing, allowing flexibility in whether the sensor is sent with or without one.

Separately, concerns were raised about the quantity of equipment needed. It was noted that only one Lidar was purchased, but three more are required, potentially taking up to a month to arrive. Furthermore, the Jetson processor (part of the Lidar solution) was not included in the purchase order or price.

To address inventory needs, it was proposed ordering at least three additional Jetsons and three additional Lidars. A delivery plan was suggested: sending one Lidar and four sensors within two weeks, followed by the remaining three Lidars later.
decisions: The initial shipment of equipment (Lidar) to Estonia will proceed while Rasmus is on vacation.
It was decided to order at least three additional Jetsons and three additional Lidars for inventory purposes.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm shipping details with Rasmus before his last day in the office.
The proposed split delivery schedule (1 Lidar/4 sensors now, 3 Lidars later) should be presented to Rasmus.
